name: Oneness
overview: Scripture reveals the foundational truth of God's oneness, affirming that the LORD our God is one, as declared in Deuteronomy 6:4 and echoed by Jesus in Mark 12:29. This unity is profound, encompassing the eternal Word who was both with God and was God from the beginning (John 1:1). The divine image in which humanity was created (Genesis 1:26) and the prophetic announcement of the Messiah as the mighty God and everlasting Father (Isaiah 9:6) further underscore the singular, unified nature of God’s person and work.
